newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sells Deutschbau for more than 2.0 bln marks.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sells Deutschbau for more than 2.0 bln marks.

text.p: The German Finance Ministry said late on Wednesday that it had sold the state property company Deutschbau to Veba Immobilien AG and Deutsche Immobilien Anlagegesellschaft mbH for more than two billion marks ($1.2 billion).

Veba Immobilien, the property arm of German utility Veba AG, was last month awarded the tender to privatise Deustchbau, which was then 58 percent-owned by the government and 42 percent-owned by the German post office.
The Finance Ministry said Deutschbau had been bought by a partnership between Veba Immobilien and Deutsche Immobilien Anlagegesellschaft, a unit of Deutsche Bank AG, with each taking 50 percent.
The ministry added that the sale had yet to be approved by monopolies and mergers authorities.
Deutschbau is one of Germany's largest property firms, with around 38,000 properties nationwide.
-- Kate Kelland, Frankfurt Newsroom +49 69 7565 1246 ($ = 1.730 German Marks)
